$comment: The e2e page's consent scenarios; tc-string.ts encodes them into site/public/tcf.js, and the page picks one with ?consent=<name> (given by default; none for no TCF consent data at all). A scenario with a TC string gets vendor consent for every GVL ID the bundle's modules declare (prebid-modules.json, from prebid.js's metadata) plus extraVendors. See AGENTS.md.

given.description: GDPR applies; consent to everything the tests need, with precise geolocation (Special Feature 1), which the id5 module needs to send the client IP

denied.description: GDPR applies; no purpose 1 consent, for vendors or the publisher

purpose1Only.description: GDPR applies; vendors have consent for purposes 1-10, but the publisher only for purpose 1, none of 2-10

notApplicable.description: GDPR doesn't apply; no TC string

extraVendors.131: ID5 (SharedID Edge's id5 module, server-side; not in the Prebid.js bundle)
